subject: types, stmtctx, *: use ZeroDate, ZeroInDate and InvalidDate related flags to replace variable in statement context (#47794)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent, focusing on executor/expression/sessionctx/statistics/table/tablecodec behavior (and the necessary types changes). The change refactors `StatementContext` date-related booleans (`IgnoreZeroInDate`, `NoZeroDate`, `AllowInvalidDate`) into `typectx.Flags` (`IgnoreZeroInDate`, `IgnoreZeroDateErr`, `IgnoreInvalidDateErr`) carried by `StmtCtx.TypeCtx()`, updates time/duration APIs to take `types.Context`, and updates per-statement flag initialization in `pkg/executor/executor.go` (including create/alter’s `WithIgnoreZeroDateErr`) plus pushdown (`PushDownFlags`) to read the new flags. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found; the new defaults (`DefaultStmtFlags` includes `FlagIgnoreZeroDateErr`) and the executor’s per-statement flag-setting preserve the prior gating behavior for zero/invalid date handling.
